title: KisanBuddy – AI-Powered Agricultural Assistant
description: Multilingual AI PWA for farmers providing crop disease diagnosis, weather hazard alerts, and real-time market price intelligence.

caseStudy.problem: Low-connectivity agricultural regions lack accessible real-time crop disease diagnosis, local market pricing intelligence, and severe weather alert mechanisms.
caseStudy.solution: Engineered a multilingual PWA leveraging an agentic Planner-Executor-Validator architecture powered by Vertex AI, SWIN Transformer, and LSTM forecasting.
caseStudy.challenges: Ensuring reliable offline functionality in rural areas with spotty connectivity and managing multi-modal data streams for real-time disease detection.
caseStudy.learnings: Mastered offline-first web design with IndexedDB AES-256 encryption, background sync workers, and agentic orchestration.
caseStudy.futureImprovements: Integrate drone imagery data streams and expanded regional language voice synthesis.

title: PhishGuard AI – Intelligent Phishing Detection System
description: Explainable AI-powered phishing detection platform identifying malicious URLs and emails with threat visualization and XAI predictions.

caseStudy.problem: Traditional phishing filters lack explainability, leaving users unaware of why specific emails or links were flagged as threats.
caseStudy.solution: Built an Explainable AI (XAI) phishing detector providing feature attribution, IP geolocation, and threat visualization dashboards.
caseStudy.challenges: Balancing model accuracy with real-time prediction speeds for interactive REST API evaluation.
caseStudy.learnings: Implemented SHAP/LIME explainability techniques with Scikit-learn classification models and Flask backend APIs.
caseStudy.futureImprovements: Deploy browser extension for real-time URL inspection.

title: Scantinel – Automated Web Vulnerability Scanner
description: Full-stack web vulnerability scanner performing 10 automated security assessment phases with real-time SSE progress and AI recommendations.

caseStudy.problem: Automated vulnerability scanning for web applications often lacks real-time visibility, unified report exports, and actionable AI-assisted remediation.
caseStudy.solution: Built a 10-phase automated security scanner with risk grading, real-time SSE updates, and automated PDF/CSV report generation.
caseStudy.challenges: Orchestrating concurrent non-blocking scan modules (SSL validation, header audits, port scans, exposed resources) safely.
caseStudy.learnings: Deepened expertise in Server-Sent Events (SSE), web security assessment protocols, and interactive dashboard state management.
caseStudy.futureImprovements: Add automated SAST/DAST pipeline integration for CI/CD runners.

title: VeriGraph AI – Propaganda & Claim Verification Platform
description: AI misinformation analysis platform tracking claim propagation across News RSS, Facebook, Telegram, GDELT, and CommonCrawl.

caseStudy.problem: Tracking viral misinformation across multi-platform news and social feeds requires low-latency collection, virality scoring, and claim verification.
caseStudy.solution: Developed an AI platform tracking claim propagation across GDELT, CommonCrawl, RSS, and social channels with confidence-based claim verification.
caseStudy.challenges: Handling high-throughput parallel data pipelines and graph network analytics in real-time.
caseStudy.learnings: Advanced NLP transformer modeling, virality scoring metrics, and asynchronous microservice architecture in FastAPI.
